decisions.reason: The page 11 crop adjustment changes tree visibility but does not change which photos must be included or where required photos are placed.
Changing the page 11 photo crop does not affect the background treatment specified for the cover, table of contents, appendix divider, or last page.
The source requests a localized photo-crop correction and does not change the document-wide layout, graphic treatment, or spacing strategy.
The page 11 crop adjustment does not alter the Agua Arc brand identity, colors, or logo requirements.
The source concerns photo framing and tree visibility, not typefaces or font sizes.
The page 11 photo-crop correction does not change the one-page letter, signature insertion, or handling of photographs displaced from the letter.
Zooming out the page 11 photograph does not necessarily change the proposal page count or its page-limit compliance rules.
The requested crop correction does not change Canva ownership, editability, asset restrictions, or source-deliverable requirements.
A page-specific photo adjustment in the current proposal does not alter the deferred reusable-template requirement.
The page 11 photograph crop has no effect on the inclusion, replacement, or structure of proposal tables.
The source does not change the number, appendix location, or integration method of team biographies.
The page 11 photo-crop correction does not affect incorporation of the organization chart.
